description: This script sets up an Apple App Store Connect API key in macOS Keychain and optionally updates related environment variables for use with Fastlane. It handles argument parsing, key file validation, storing the key securely, and managing environment variable files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays the usage information for the script.

methods.name: upsert_env_line
methods.description: Inserts or updates a line in the specified environment file with a given key and value.

methods.name: delete_env_line
methods.description: Removes a line with a specific key from the environment file.
